role: Walk through previously observed open lattice cells
acquisition: The preceding public pulse reveals the cells; the actual first move confirms the carrier at its announced destination.
reuse: Same observed lattice, unique carrier at prior expected cell, destination already free and no route cell newly contradicted or occupied.
refutation: Unreadable or ambiguous carrier, wrong displacement, known terrain contradiction, observed hazard on the remaining route, or official boundary.
conclusion: The only new terrain fact is a cell outside the committed route, uncovered by a moving obstacle; all four remaining destinations retain their premises. The original next-step guard admits continuation.
